cacheDiagnosis.verdict: The duplicate navigation RSC is explained by a fulfilled partial metadata fallback selected ahead of an exact Pending Full metadata entry. Pending Full data entries are reused. The revalidation-side-slot hypothesis is not the observed mechanism.
cacheDiagnosis.units: All event/request/resource times are milliseconds relative to native click. Cache entry IDs are local to each browser context.

routeFulfillResolution.meaning: Safely inside getRenderedSearchFromVaryPath(n) initializer; all referenced variables are function parameters; before route fulfillment assignments.

dynamicWriteResolution.meaning: At build-ID guard; all referenced variables are function parameters. Records write entry only, not success. Subsequent segment fulfills and navigation reads show completion.

sourceOwners.role: Navigation reads canonical entries, first onlyMatchFulfilled=true then fallback lookup allowing Pending.
Revalidation insert uses normal slot when exact canonical parent is empty.
Fulfilled-only lookup skips Pending exact match and recurses into less-specific Fallback.
LoadingBoundary metadata varies on Fallback search params; Full metadata uses concrete search string.
Navigation can wait on Pending Full data instead of refetching it.
Actual metadata entry read; partial fulfilled head selected by lookup.
Partial cached head requires a dynamic request.
Dynamic request combines missing segment data or head.
Full dynamic response cache writing entry point.

limitations: Browser-only interventions and Debugger logpoints add overhead; two runs do not establish latency improvement.
Playwright response routing buffers the held headers/body and disables HTTP cache. This is a causal ordering test, not a production request topology estimate.
Fulfill logpoints execute before synchronous assignments. Later cache reads confirm the observed Full fulfilled entries.
Dynamic-write-start alone does not establish successful completion.
The object search-param Fallback key is an interior key, distinct from a terminal Revalidation child slot.
This proves the reason for the extra request in these controlled runs, not every extra RSC in all navigation scenarios.
